resources.string:
Please read and understand the following before use:

## 1. Nature

NexPort is a local AI gateway / reverse proxy running on this device only (127.0.0.1). It provides no model service itself; it forwards requests between upstream services you configure and your clients.

## 2. Your data

Account credentials, API keys and call logs are stored in a local database (credentials encrypted). Back up responsibly; data loss from misoperation, restore, or system reset is on you.

## 3. Open source

NexPort is built upon ClawProxyHub (AGPL-3.0) with modifications; this fork is released under AGPL-3.0. The full license and third-party notices are in “About & Licenses”; the complete corresponding source is available in the fork repository (https://github.com/bilieebiliee1-design/ClawProxyHub, same link as the “About” page); see the “About” page for the upstream project and modification notes.

## 1. Third-party behavior

Plugins and upstream sites are outside the control of this app: plugin code, upstream API changes, and anti-abuse policies may cause failures or account restrictions/bans. Installing means you accept these risks.

## 2. Tunnel exposes the gateway

The temporary tunnel (OFF by default) exposes the gateway API on a public ephemeral domain (\*.trycloudflare.com). Once enabled, your cph-\* API keys are the only line of defense. Disconnect when unused.

Open the panel → Plugins → Marketplace. All 10 Go plugins from the official source index are pre-bundled with the APK and load automatically at core start — no installation needed. Lua plugins can be installed online via Marketplace / Custom source / Offline upload.
The tunnel exposes the gateway API on a public ephemeral domain; cph-* keys are the only defense. Enable it on the home screen only when needed and disconnect after use.

The gateway and task scheduler run in a foreground service; disabling battery optimization for this app is recommended. Timed tasks may drift under Doze. With the floating window you can check gateway status from any screen.
Notifications not granted: the background service still runs, but the status notification and quick actions are hidden. You can enable it later in Settings.
LAN listening is ON by default

Besides 127.0.0.1, the core also listens on the device\'s LAN address at the same port by default: only /v1 (API-key auth enforced) and /health are exposed; the panel and admin API are never reachable. The LAN endpoint is shown on Home; LAN listening can be disabled in the panel settings.

This build pre-bundles all 10 Go plugins from the official source index: cline, commandcode, ima, lobsterai, mirasim, newapi, opencode, todofor, workbuddy and zcode — loaded automatically at core start, no installation needed. Android forbids executing downloaded binaries from app data (targetSdk 29+ noexec), so Go plugins cannot be installed/upgraded online; they update with the APK.

The panel “Plugins → Marketplace” annotates Android availability per plugin: bundled Go plugins show their bundled version with no upgrade button; non-bundled Go plugins are marked not-installable with the reason; Lua plugins are unrestricted and install online as usual.

Vendor systems restrict background execution and autostart differently: please allow NexPort to “autostart / run in background” in system settings (MIUI, EMUI etc. put it under “App management → Autostart”; guided as far as each vendor allows), together with ignoring battery optimization and the foreground service.
